text: player
Island Adventure
The group from One Han City sets foot on the mysterious island alongside Frieren, the mage from another world.
Ichihime
So this is where the fog is coming from, nyaa? It looks completely normal so far, nyaa.
Quite peaceful and serene, actually.
Kaavi
No. I have a premonition that trouble brews beneath the surface.
Yuzu
Argh... As much as I hate agreeing with Kaavi, I can feel something off, too.
The fog right now is surging with life mana... It feels just like a monster breathing right down our necks!
Leia
There's more than one mana surge... each varying in strength.
Ms. Frieren, have you noticed anything?
Frieren
Yes. Though these mana signatures differ, they weave together into a single barrier covering the entire island.
Strangely enough, I feel I can cast magic here just as I usually do.
Let's take a closer look.
Nyaa?! I thought this was a deserted island! Who knew there'd be such a huge complex here, nyaa... Even if it's all run-down.
By the way, what's with all these weird markings on the walls and floor, nyaa?
A blessing, perhaps, or a curse... Either way, they are echoes of fate.
Isn't it obvious?! It has to be whoever's behind the fog!
This isn't just random scrawling. It reeks of ancient magic... and the rune layout is super creepy!
...Argh?
As they speak, something glimmers deep within the ancient ruins.
A scrying crystal ball? I've never seen one shaped quite like this... But one thing is certain: it is spewing out fog-infused mana.
Is this a magical item unique to your world?
Let me try to analyze it, too.
Be careful. Keep an eye out for bizarre magic.
Watch out for traps. There might be hidden mechanisms.
I'm actually quite strong.
With Frieren's assistance, we quickly decipher the spell formula inside the crystal ball.
It's a spell that only lifts when certain conditions are met.
The fog's magic is directly linked to the crystal ball. To dispel it, we must first determine what image the crystal is projecting.
Then, we need to gather the corresponding ingredients and use an alchemy circle to craft the key item for each crystal ball.
Only then will the crystal stop generating more enchanted fog.
It seems we'll be staying on this island a while longer.
Still, the ingredients are all scattered across the island. That, too, is a thread woven by fate.
In that case, let's get moving, nyaa! ...What do we need to do first, nyaa?
We witches will stay here and analyze the images in the crystal ball.
Then I'll head outside to search for materials, nyaa... What about you, Master?
Keep exploring the ruins.
Do you want to stay and study those squiggles, Master?
I don't get them at all... I'll leave you to it then, nyaa.
As I stare at the strange etchings, a sudden haze clouds my mind.
When I come to, I find myself in a completely unfamiliar space.
Where am I? How did I get here?
I search the stone walls and tiled floor for anything that might guide me, yet even my recent footsteps leave no trace.
The surrounding fog abruptly thickens, pulsing as if alive.
Who's there?
A translucent hand formed of mist silently materializes beside me and reaches out.
Oh no!
<color=#6CC2B6>Zoltraak!</color>
In the nick of time, a beam of magic pierces through, dispelling the entity.
Frieren stands at the far end of the passageway, appearing out of nowhere.
...Good, I made it in time.
This island is far trickier than it looks. It's best to tread carefully.
Thanks, Frieren.
Let's save the area ahead for another time.
Yep! Let's leave those squiggles to the pros, nyaa!
I don't understand them at all, so I'd rather look around outside with you, Master!
Following the deciphered directions, I begin my search for the target alongside Ichihime.
Look over there, Master! Is that what we need for the crystal ball, nyaa?
Oh! Great job, Ichihime!
Talk about a smooth search, just like a Riichi Ippatsu, nyaa!
The moment Ichihime extends her hand, the surrounding fog abruptly thickens.
A translucent hand formed of mist silently materializes beside her and reaches out.
Ichihime, watch out!
In the nick of time, a beam of magic pierces through, dispelling the entity.
Frieren stands behind us, appearing out of nowhere.
That was a close call.
Let's save the area ahead for another time.
Returning to the crystal ball with Frieren, we find Leia and the others have already prepared the magic circle.
Argh... Are these ingredients alright? They won't just blow up in our faces, will they?
As the magic circle glows, the fog takes physical form once more.
The monster's back, nyaa!
If you please, Ms. Frieren!
Got it. //n<size=50><color=#6CC2B6>Zoltraak!</color></size>
The fog has lifted a bit.
Not just here – I can feel the fog across the entire island beginning to thin.
Explore ruins, locate the crystal ball, break the spell... Argh, is it going to be like this the whole way?
It seems so... Our journey here looks set to take quite some time. Why don't we rest a bit before moving on?
Yes, tidying this place up to serve as our base of operations sounds like a fine idea.
However, before anyone can truly relax...
THUD!
What on earth is this blocky monster?! It's insanely strong!
That voice... Is it coming from farther down the corridor?
{var:player_nickname}, Ichihime, follow me.
Let's go investigate.
We approach closer to the source of the noise...
I'll provide cover, Mr. Stark.
Got it! Next strike goes here, right, Fern?
Monster
ROAR!
The mahjong tiles came alive and are attacking, nyaa?!
Fern
No matter how many times we knock it down, it keeps getting back up...
Stark
Isn't there any way to finish this thing off for good?!
This will turn into a war of attrition at this rate. Should I use a more powerful spell to blast it away all at once?
...No way! That'll collapse the whole corridor!
Looks like they need help.
{var:player_nickname}, can you spot the monster's weak point?
Even if you ask me that...
A monster made of mahjong tiles – its limbs form triplets and sequences, while its chest, back, and head each bear an identical tile.
Wait, fifteen tiles... four sets and a pair...
That's exactly one tile over a winning hand!
I've got it!
Hit it on the head!
Aim for the center!
Since there's one tile too many, all that's needed is to discard it!
BOOM!
A beam of magic strikes the weak point with pinpoint accuracy, obliterating the extra tile.
With that tile "discarded," the remaining tiles on the monster align perfectly into a winning hand.
The monster freezes, then dissolves into the thinning fog.
It worked... It's not getting back up.
Phew... That's finally over.
Ms. Frieren! What a relief to see you again.
Just as I sensed earlier, Frieren ended up here too... Ah, and who are you guys?
Were you the ones who helped us just now...?
That's a long story, nyaa...
With Frieren leading the way, we head toward the nearest source of mana.
Glad to see you two are unhurt, Fern, Stark.
Who'd actually live in a place like this and leave all this graffiti, nyaa?
Join the search for materials.
Oh no, nyaa!
The vision in the crystal ball matches... Now!
Don't worry, {var:player_nickname}.
